text:
sophie: Heads up — final-round with candidate @alex Thu 11:00 PT. Two quick asks: who will own the debrief doc, and do we capture ASR transcript (consent) + where to drop it? Also want a tiny rule for rating consistency across interviewers (avoid drift).

priya: I can own debrief notes if nobody else volunteers. I'll spin up the doc and add a scribe template. We should only enable ASR if candidate explicitly consents in the event.

samir: +1 for Priya owning it. For consistency: stick to the 5-point rubric but add a one-line "confidence" field (low/med/high) on each score. Ask interviewers to add 3 bullets: 1) top strength, 2) top risk, 3) recommended next step. Also request a 10m buffer for handoff.

lina: @sophie practical suggestion — put this short block into the calendar event description so it's easy to follow during the call. Example:

``
Debrief doc: <link to doc>
Scribe: Priya
ASR transcript: candidate consent required — record yes/no in event
Post-call: 10m buffer reserved for notes (please stay on call)
Rubric link: <company rubrics>/eng-5pt
``

people-ops-bot: Template created: https://drive.company.com/people-ops/interview-debriefs/1769001234-sophie (scribe section included).

calendar-bot: Event updated — added 10m buffer after meeting and set "Debrief owner" = Priya. Reminder 5m before to ask candidate consent for transcripts.

sophie: Nice. Priya — can you paste the scribe checklist into the doc? Quick suggested checklist to copy in:

``
- Capture 3 key strengths
- Capture 2 risks / unknowns
- One-line hire/no-hire rationale
- Confidence (low/med/high) for each rubric section
- Note any calibration concerns under "fidelity" header
``

priya: On it — adding now. Pinged interviewers: @samir @lina please confirm you can stay 10m after the interview to land notes.

samir: Confirmed, will stay for the buffer.

lina: Confirmed. Quick Q: if scores differ >2 points, do we escalate to HM or just annotate? I propose annotate + flag HM for >2 point spread.

sophie: Agree — annotate disagreement and flag HM if spread >2. Add a one-line calibration note if you think your scoring was conservative/liberal. Let's try one short calibration session weekly.

priya: Done — doc updated and link pasted in event. ASR consent checkbox added to the top of doc. Scribe checklist copied.

sophie: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll verbally prompt consent at the start of the interview and remind people about the 10m buffer. Closing loop unless anyone raises blockers.

lina: no blockers from me.

samir: All good.
